author: Kushal
problem: Read N and a string S of A, B and C that contains each letter at least once. Print how many characters must be read from the left until A, B and C have all appeared.
bug_description: Loops over range(N) instead of range(N+1), so when the last character completes the set the loop ends before printing.

comments.accurate: Prints how many leading characters of S are needed to see A, B and C
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the count of characters read once A, B and C have appeared, checked before each new character
comments.wrong_location: Loop length verified; check that letters other than A, B and C still advance the count
